text:
Lina (Finance): Acme flagged a huge embed bill spike this morning — +120k embed units between 03:00-04:00 UTC, customer is asking for explanation and refund.
Raj (Eng-Infra): looking into logs now, can you drop the query/results you used?
Lina (Finance): pasted the quick aggregate I ran:
```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) as hour, sum(units) as embed_units
FROM embed_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme'
  AND ts >= '2026-03-19 01:00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
-- result: 02:00 -> 8,100 | 03:00 -> 128,100 | 04:00 -> 7,900
```
Marta (Eng-SRE): 128k in that hour looks like duplication, not usage pattern. Any correlating infra events? ops-bot, did we roll anything in eu region overnight?
ops-bot: Deploy: rolling restart eu-proxy-2 at 2026-03-19T03:02:17Z; Deploy: proxy-config v2.8 -> v2.9; No autoscaler events in that window.
Raj (Eng-Infra): I see repeated ack receipts from eu-proxy-2 to ingestion-shard-7 at 03:02:22Z with same ack_id in logs. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T03:02:22Z] eu-proxy-2 INFO ack_id=abcd1234 status=acked
[2026-03-19T03:02:22Z] ingest-shard-7 WARN ack_id=abcd1234 duplicate-ack
[2026-03-19T03:02:22Z] eu-proxy-2 INFO ack_id=abcd1234 status=acked
```
Raj (Eng-Infra): looks like during the proxy reload we sent the same batch twice to the ingest tier for ~3–4 minutes. That matches the time window.
Marta (Eng-SRE): confirmed via checksum counts: unique rows in that window are ~64k but recorded units are ~128k. So ~2x duplication.
Lina (Finance): customer billed for 128,100; true unique count is ~64,050 -> overcount ~64,050 units. We should propose a credit for the overcount + small buffer for rounding. Suggest credit 65k embed units.
Oliver (Product): what's typical $/embed unit for Acme? This is a promo account with tier pricing, unit value = $0.005 per embed unit? (example)
Lina (Finance): on their contract embeds are billed at $0.0045 per unit. 65k * $0.0045 = $292.5.
Michael (Finance-Lead): rough sanity check OK. We need approval to issue invoice adjustment and to mark as non-recurring credit. Please attach RCA and ops mitigation plan.
Raj (Eng-Infra): RCA: rolling reload of eu-proxy-2 triggered duplicate POSTs due to race in graceful shutdown path; duplication window 03:02:17 -> 03:06:10 UTC. Mitigation: patch in-flight dedupe by ack_id at ingress service + backfill dedupe job.
Marta (Eng-SRE): will run a one-off backfill to dedupe ingestion records and update the metering ledger. ETA 2h to run and validate. Will put a hold on ledger export for the affected invoice run.
Lina (Finance): can we get a produced signed number for credit so I can send to Acme support?
Raj (Eng-Infra): after backfill ledger will show true embed_count = 64,050 for that hour. I'll confirm exact overcount delta post-job. Probable credit = 64,050 units.
Lina (Finance): ok. Please confirm delta before we create the credit memo. Also include a short customer note: brief cause + assurance of fix.
Oliver (Product): draft note suggestion: "We observed duplicate ingestion during a proxy rolling update which led to overstated embed usage for your account between 03:02–03:06 UTC on 2026-03-19. We've corrected the ingestion ledger and issued a credit for the overcount. We implemented a fix to prevent replays during proxy restarts. Apologies for the disruption."
Michael (Finance-Lead): approve credit up to $300 (65k units). Final amount to be set after Marta's backfill validation. Lina proceed with preliminary customer communication and mark ticket Pending Approval in billing queue.
Lina (Finance): will file credit memo draft and attach MCA (ops RCA) when Raj/Marta confirm numbers. CCing support to notify Acme.
Marta (Eng-SRE): backfill completed — ledger now shows 64,052 unique units in that hour, recorded previously 128,102. Overcount = 64,050. Pushing adjusted export to billing queue.
Lina (Finance): received final delta. Creating credit memo: 64,050 units @ $0.0045 = $288.225 -> round to $288.23.
Lina (Finance): Michael — request final signoff to apply $288.23 credit and notify customer.
Michael (Finance-Lead): signed off. Apply credit, mark as operational credit (non-recurring), and add note linking to internal incident #INC-2026-417. Good catch team.
Oliver (Product): can we add a small postmortem link when ready. I'll coordinate the customer-facing postmortem with Support.
Lina (Finance): thanks. Closing loop once memo posted. :thumbsup:"
